evidence.ai-context: Prior MEDIUM closed: links.ts:54 rejects a normalised pathname that starts with two slashes or backslashes. links.ts:58-65 re-parses the emitted href and requires the same origin and the same pathname, or returns text. Executed in a reviewer vitest fuzz of 483 hrefs, made of 87 hand-picked payloads plus a generated 9x11x4 grid. Grid prefixes: /, /./, /../, /a/../, /%2e/, /%2E%2E/, /.%2e/, /a/%2e%2e/, /./../. Grid middles: /, backslash, %2f, %5c, %2F, %5C, TAB+/, LF+/, /%2f, backslash+/, /+backslash. Grid hosts: evil.example, @evil.example, evil.example:443, evil.example/x?y#z. The hand-picked set adds backslash forms, %2f%2f, %5c%5c, TAB/LF/CR/NUL/space, NBSP, U+2028, BOM, fullwidth solidus, U+2215, U+2044, dot segments in plain and encoded forms, ';' segments, double-encoded %252e, query/hash '//', userinfo, javascript: in mixed case, with leading space, TAB/LF inside, :, %3a, entity-encoded and with a leading control char, data:, DATA:, vbscript:, blob:, file:, ftp:, mailto:, https:host, https:/host, https:\\host, userinfo confusion, a backslash-@ trick, and http:///host. Result: internal 172, external 30, text 281, 0 unsafe. Every internal href resolves to the site origin, starts with a single '/' and contains no raw backslash or control char. Every external href is http(s) with a host, and the protocol-relative and backslash forms normalise to https://evil.example/ with a new tab. The specific payloads /.//, /..//, /a/..//, /%2e//, /%2e%2e//, /./\evil, /\t/ and /\n/ all return 'text'. Encoded slashes such as /%2f%2fevil.example stay internal, and a left click in BrowserRouter lands on http://localhost:3000/%2f%2fevil.example: same origin, no decode into //, no SecurityError. The same holds for 13 other payloads. A DOM test rendered all 483 as markdown links plus image, reference, autolink and raw-HTML payloads: 280 anchors, 254 same-origin, 26 cross-origin and all 26 target=_blank with rel=noopener. Prior image LOW closed: MarkdownRenderer.tsx:81 maps img to alt text. ![x](https://evil.example/p.png?d=secret), reference-style images, a linked image and raw produced 0 /
evidence.owasp-top-10: Open redirect (_redirects): the reviewer parser (scratchpad redir-check2.mjs) checked dist/_redirects. It has 12 rules, every one a 301, and every target is a fixed same-origin path (/services or /services/<slug>) with no :placeholder, no splat substitution, no encoded slash or backslash, and no scheme or host. Sources sit only under /solutions, /solutions/*, /industries, /industries/ and /industry/*. 21 protected paths were checked and none is shadowed: /, /_headers, /_redirects, /assets/*.js, /assets/*.woff2, /images/*, /api/chat, /api/contact, /services, /services/, /services/website-design, /contact, /about, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /favicon.ico, /404.html, /logo.png, /realisation, /insights, /careers. No target is itself a source, so there are no loops. Hostile inputs /solutions/https://evil.example, /solutions//evil.example, /industry/%2f%2fevil.example and /solutions/x?next=//evil.example all map to the constant /services. The repo's tests/redirects.test.mjs passes 10/10, and smoke.test.mjs passes 18/18. XSS sinks: the only dangerouslySetInnerHTML in src is still src/components/ui/chart.tsx:70 (unused, unchanged), and the delta adds no innerHTML, document.write, eval or new Function. getSeo now does a plain STATIC_SEO[path] lookup (hasOwnProperty removed). This is safe because normalizePath always prefixes '/': a reviewer test of __proto__, /__proto__, constructor, /constructor, toString, /hasOwnProperty and others shows all of them return the noindex 404 data. CtaLink treats any href starting with '/' as an internal Link, but its inputs are build-time constants only (bookingHref() / '/contact'), never untrusted input. The repo suites relevant to the delta (22 files, 340 tests including reviewer probes) all pass.

findings.summary: Carried over from 1592f18 (was line 24), still open. `import.meta.env?.VITE_SITE_URL` stops Vite from replacing only that one key. The bundle emits an env object, today the empty literal `Uu={}`, and stays leak-free only because the optimiser drops the unused keys. This matters while a VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY may still be set in the Cloudflare Pages build environment. Verified dist has 0 secret patterns, so nothing leaks today.
findings.fix: Change to `import.meta.env.VITE_SITE_URL as string | undefined` (the static form, as at openai.service.ts:45). Ops: delete VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY from the Cloudflare Pages environment (owner action carried from the develop review).
findings.recommendation: Small chore, before the develop -> main release.

findings.summary: Carried over from 1592f18, unchanged. The preview middleware calls existsSync on an un-normalised req.url, which tells a caller whether a directory exists outside dist. It serves no file content, it only runs in the local preview, and preview binds to localhost.
findings.fix: Resolve the path against distDir and require target.startsWith(distDir + path.sep) before calling existsSync.

findings.summary: Carried over from 1592f18. With /api/chat live, the backend must treat client `history` as untrusted, rate-limit and token-cap the endpoint, and remove the retired unverified facts from the system prompt and knowledge base. The frontend side is unchanged in this delta.
findings.fix: Backend review of /api/chat covering Zod validation, the role allowlist, caps, the rate limit and a prompt/KB grep for 2765, 783-0443, calendly and info@.
findings.recommendation: Track in the backend repo before enabling chat in production.

findings.summary: Carried over from 1592f18. A production build accepts http://localhost as VITE_API_URL, and build:verify injects http://localhost:3001. If the Cloudflare build command were ever build:verify, the live site would POST contact and chat data to the visitor's own localhost.
findings.fix: Keep the Cloudflare build command as `npm run build`. Optionally reject localhost when CF_PAGES === '1'.

findings.summary: Carried over. No threat model exists, and docs/security/ is absent at 61bc09e, while the contact and AI chat boundaries are live.

findings.recommendation: Before the backend chat goes live.

verdict_rationale: This delta introduces no critical, high or medium finding. The prior MEDIUM (links.ts dot-segment //host bypass) is closed: 483 hostile hrefs, a full DOM render and live left-click navigation never produced an off-origin internal link or a non-http(s) link. The prior image LOW is closed: no is rendered from a bot reply. public/_redirects is a fixed table of 301s to same-origin paths, with no placeholder or splat in any target and no shadowing of assets, headers or API paths, so it is not an open redirect. The contact page still posts only to ${VITE_API_URL}/api/contact through the unchanged submitter, and it renders no unverified fact or secret. The delta adds no new secret and no new HTML sink. One prior LOW (seo.ts:21) and four INFO items remain open and are carried forward, together with the owner action on VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY.
